# Shruti 1.4.30
- Mixer controls send the latest fader position without building up obsolete commands. Faders show decibels, retain the existing saved volume curve, and support Shift for fine adjustment. - Clear all solos with one control or Command–Shift–S. Option-click Solo to hear only that app. - Remove apps immediately and restore them from Add App → Removed, retaining their saved mix. Removed apps stay out of Solo, Smart processing and routing until restored. - Recent sound activity is easier to find in either list order. App identities and activity labels no longer wrap into narrow vertical text. - Global EQ now has a clearly named control. Use the built-in eight-band EQ and up to two installed Audio Unit effects, searchable by plugin or manufacturer. VST3-only effects require their Audio Unit version. - Rapid Smart and Global EQ changes preserve command order and discard obsolete unsent settings. Smart switches no longer wait for synchronous device discovery. - Removing a plugin while it loads no longer allows an obsolete load to reappear.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Existing settings are preserved. Follow Me, Auto Duck, Loudness Guard and Mic Follow have automated DSP/policy coverage; live microphone transitions and speaker/TV/headset listening have not been certified across hardware. Loudness Guard is a per-app sample-peak limiter, not an intersample true-peak or post-mix hardware limiter.
